bn.title: ওয়েবিনার 27 | ডাঃ মিনা ওহমান | ক্রনিক কম - গ্রেড প্রদাহ এবং চাপ
bn.description:
দীর্ঘস্থায়ী মৃদু প্রদাহ এবং মানসিক চাপ প্রায়শই অদৃশ্য থাকে, কিন্তু এগুলো নীরবে আমাদের দৈনন্দিন স্বাস্থ্য, কর্মশক্তি এবং দীর্ঘমেয়াদী সুস্থতাকে প্রভাবিত করে। প্যান ইন্ডিয়া আয়োজিত এই জ্ঞানগর্ভ ওয়েবিনারে, ডঃ মিনা ওহম্যান ব্যাখ্যা করেছেন কীভাবে এই অন্তর্নিহিত কারণগুলো আমাদের জীবনযাত্রার অভ্যাসকে প্রভাবিত করে এবং এগুলোকে কার্যকরভাবে সামলানোর জন্য আমরা কী করতে পারি।

এই সেশনে, আপনি জানতে পারবেন কীভাবে দীর্ঘস্থায়ী প্রদাহ তীব্র প্রদাহ থেকে আলাদা, কীভাবে মানসিক চাপ শারীরবৃত্তীয় স্তরে শরীরকে প্রভাবিত করে এবং কেন আধুনিক জীবনযাত্রা এই সমস্যাগুলোকে ত্বরান্বিত করছে। ডঃ ওহম্যান প্রদাহ কমাতে, সহনশীলতা বাড়াতে এবং টেকসই স্বাস্থ্যকর অভ্যাস গড়ে তুলতে লাইফস্টাইল মেডিসিনের উপর ভিত্তি করে কিছু বাস্তবসম্মত ও বিজ্ঞান-সমর্থিত কৌশলও তুলে ধরেছেন।

আপনি একজন স্বাস্থ্যকর্মী, শিক্ষার্থী, বা নিজের সুস্থতাকে আরও ভালোভাবে বুঝতে আগ্রহী যেই হোন না কেন, এই ওয়েবিনারটি আজকের অন্যতম গুরুত্বপূর্ণ স্বাস্থ্য বিষয়টির উপর একটি স্পষ্ট এবং কার্যকরী দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি প্রদান করে।

আলোচিত মূল বিষয়সমূহ:
দীর্ঘস্থায়ী মৃদু প্রদাহের ব্যাখ্যা
মানসিক চাপ এবং প্রদাহের মধ্যে সম্পর্ক
দীর্ঘমেয়াদী স্বাস্থ্য ঝুঁকির কারণ জীবনযাত্রার অভ্যাসসমূহ
প্রাকৃতিকভাবে প্রদাহ কমানোর সহজ ও কার্যকরী উপায়
সার্বিক স্বাস্থ্যে পুষ্টি, ঘুম এবং শারীরিক কার্যকলাপের ভূমিকা

বক্তা:
ডঃ মিনা ওহম্যান
চিকিৎসক বিজ্ঞানী এবং লাইফস্টাইল মেডিসিন বিশেষজ্ঞ

তারিখ: ১৪ মার্চ ২০২৬
আয়োজক: প্যান ইন্ডিয়া

এই সেশনটি যদি আপনার মূল্যবান মনে হয়, তাহলে স্বাস্থ্য, জীবনধারা এবং সুস্থতা নিয়ে আরও আলোচনার জন্য লাইক, শেয়ার এবং সাবস্ক্রাইব করতে ভুলবেন না।

#দীর্ঘস্থায়ীপ্রদাহ #মানসিকচাপব্যবস্থাপনা #লাইফস্টাইলমেডিসিন #স্বাস্থ্যওয়েবিনার #প্রতিরোধমূলকস্বাস্থ্য #ওয়েলনেসইন্ডিয়া #প্যানইন্ডিয়া #স্বাস্থ্যকরজীবনযাপন #মনশরীরস্বাস্থ্য

pa.title: ਵੈਬਿਨਾਰ 27 | ਡਾ: ਮੀਨਾ ਓਹਮਾਨ | ਗੰਭੀਰ ਘੱਟ - ਗ੍ਰੇਡ ਸੋਜਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਤਣਾਅ
pa.description:
ਲੰਬੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟ-ਦਰਜੇ ਦੀ ਸੋਜਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਤਣਾਅ ਅਕਸਰ ਅਦਿੱਖ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਇਹ ਚੁੱਪ-ਚਾਪ ਸਾਡੀ ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਸਿਹਤ, ਊਰਜਾ ਦੇ ਪੱਧਰਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਲੰਬੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੀ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਆਕਾਰ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਪੈਨ ਇੰਡੀਆ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਆਯੋਜਿਤ ਇਸ ਸੂਝਵਾਨ ਵੈਬਿਨਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ, ਡਾ. ਮੀਨਾ ਓਹਮਨ ਦੱਸਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਇਹ ਅੰਤਰੀਵ ਕਾਰਕ ਸਾਡੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਆਦਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਤ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਅਸੀਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਸ਼ਾਲੀ ਢੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ ਲਈ ਕੀ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਾਂ।

ਇਸ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ, ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸਿੱਖੋਗੇ ਕਿ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਸੋਜਸ਼ ਤੀਬਰ ਸੋਜਸ਼ ਤੋਂ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਹੈ, ਤਣਾਅ ਸਰੀਰ ਨੂੰ ਸਰੀਰਕ ਪੱਧਰ 'ਤੇ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਆਧੁਨਿਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਮੁੱਦਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਉਂ ਤੇਜ਼ ਕਰ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ। ਡਾ. ਓਹਮਨ ਸੋਜਸ਼ ਨੂੰ ਘਟਾਉਣ, ਲਚਕੀਲੇਪਣ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਟਿਕਾਊ ਸਿਹਤਮੰਦ ਆਦਤਾਂ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਜੀਵਨ ਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਦਵਾਈ ਵਿੱਚ ਜੜ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਵਿਹਾਰਕ, ਵਿਗਿਆਨ-ਸਮਰਥਿਤ ਰਣਨੀਤੀਆਂ ਵੀ ਸਾਂਝੀਆਂ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।

ਭਾਵੇਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇੱਕ ਸਿਹਤ ਪੇਸ਼ੇਵਰ, ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ, ਜਾਂ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਹੋ ਜੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਖੁਦ ਦੀ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਢੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਸਮਝਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਹ ਵੈਬਿਨਾਰ ਅੱਜ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ ਸਿਹਤ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਇੱਕ 'ਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਰਜਸ਼ੀਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀਕੋਣ ਪੇਸ਼ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਮੁੱਖ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ:
ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਘੱਟ-ਦਰਜੇ ਦੀ ਸੋਜਸ਼ ਬਾਰੇ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਗਿਆ
ਤਣਾਅ ਅਤੇ ਸੋਜਸ਼ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਸਬੰਧ
ਜੀਵਨਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਆਦਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਲੰਬੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੇ ਸਿਹਤ ਜੋਖਮਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਯੋਗਦਾਨ ਪਾਉਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ
ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਸੋਜਸ਼ ਨੂੰ ਘਟਾਉਣ ਦੇ ਸਰਲ, ਵਿਹਾਰਕ ਤਰੀਕੇ
ਸਮੁੱਚੀ ਸਿਹਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੋਸ਼ਣ, ਨੀਂਦ ਅਤੇ ਅੰਦੋਲਨ ਦੀ ਭੂਮਿਕਾ

ਸਪੀਕਰ:

ਡਾ. ਮੀਨਾ ਓਹਮਾਨ
ਡਾਕਟਰ ਵਿਗਿਆਨੀ ਅਤੇ ਜੀਵਨ ਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਦਵਾਈ ਮਾਹਰ

ਮਿਤੀ: 14 ਮਾਰਚ 2026
ਪੈਨ ਇੰਡੀਆ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਮੇਜ਼ਬਾਨੀ

ਜੇਕਰ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਇਹ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ ਕੀਮਤੀ ਲੱਗਿਆ, ਤਾਂ ਸਿਹਤ, ਜੀਵਨ ਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਅਤੇ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਹੋਰ ਗੱਲਬਾਤ ਲਈ ਪਸੰਦ ਕਰਨਾ, ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਗਾਹਕੀ ਲੈਣਾ ਨਾ ਭੁੱਲੋ।

#ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਸੋਜਸ਼ #ਤਣਾਅ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਨ #ਜੀਵਨਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਦਵਾਈ #ਸਿਹਤਵੈਬਿਨਾਰ #ਰੋਕੂ ਸਿਹਤ #ਵੈਲਨੈਸ ਇੰਡੀਆ #ਪੈਨ ਇੰਡੀਆ #ਸਿਹਤਮੰਦ ਜੀਵਨ #ਮਨ-ਸਰੀਰ ਸਿਹਤ

hi.title: वेबिनार 27 | डॉ मीना ओहमान | दीर्घकालिक निम्न-श्रेणी की सूजन और तनाव
hi.description:
दीर्घकालिक निम्न-स्तरीय सूजन और तनाव अक्सर अदृश्य होते हैं, लेकिन ये चुपचाप हमारे दैनिक स्वास्थ्य, ऊर्जा स्तर और दीर्घकालिक कल्याण को प्रभावित करते हैं। पैन इंडिया द्वारा आयोजित इस ज्ञानवर्धक वेबिनार में, डॉ. मीना ओहमैन विस्तार से बताती हैं कि ये अंतर्निहित कारक हमारी जीवनशैली की आदतों को कैसे प्रभावित करते हैं और हम इन्हें प्रभावी ढंग से कैसे नियंत्रित कर सकते हैं।

इस सत्र में, आप जानेंगे कि दीर्घकालिक सूजन, तीव्र सूजन से कैसे भिन्न होती है, तनाव शरीर को शारीरिक स्तर पर कैसे प्रभावित करता है, और आधुनिक जीवनशैली इन समस्याओं को क्यों बढ़ा रही है। डॉ. ओहमैन जीवनशैली चिकित्सा पर आधारित व्यावहारिक, वैज्ञानिक रूप से समर्थित रणनीतियाँ भी साझा करती हैं जो सूजन को कम करने, लचीलापन बढ़ाने और स्थायी स्वस्थ आदतें बनाने में मदद करती हैं।

चाहे आप स्वास्थ्य पेशेवर हों, छात्र हों, या कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति हों जो अपने स्वयं के कल्याण को बेहतर ढंग से समझना चाहता हो, यह वेबिनार आज के सबसे महत्वपूर्ण स्वास्थ्य विषयों में से एक पर स्पष्ट और व्यावहारिक दृष्टिकोण प्रदान करता है।

मुख्य विषय:
दीर्घकालिक निम्न-स्तरीय सूजन की व्याख्या
तनाव और सूजन के बीच संबंध
जीवनशैली की आदतें जो दीर्घकालिक स्वास्थ्य जोखिमों में योगदान करती हैं
सूजन को प्राकृतिक रूप से कम करने के सरल और व्यावहारिक तरीके
समग्र स्वास्थ्य में पोषण, नींद और व्यायाम की भूमिका

वक्ता:
डॉ. मीना ओहमैन
चिकित्सक वैज्ञानिक और जीवनशैली चिकित्सा विशेषज्ञ

दिनांक: 14 मार्च 2026
पैन इंडिया द्वारा आयोजित

यदि आपको यह सत्र उपयोगी लगा, तो स्वास्थ्य, जीवनशैली और कल्याण से संबंधित और अधिक चर्चाओं के लिए लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करना न भूलें।

nl-NL.title: WEBINAR 27 | Dr. Miina Öhman | Chronische laaggradige ontstekingen en stress
nl-NL.description:
Chronische, laaggradige ontstekingen en stress zijn vaak onzichtbaar, maar ze beïnvloeden ongemerkt onze dagelijkse gezondheid, energieniveaus en welzijn op de lange termijn. In dit inzichtelijke webinar, georganiseerd door PAN India, legt Dr. Miina Öhman uit hoe deze onderliggende factoren onze leefstijl beïnvloeden en wat we kunnen doen om ze effectief te beheersen.

In deze sessie leert u hoe chronische ontsteking verschilt van acute ontsteking, hoe stress het lichaam op fysiologisch niveau beïnvloedt en waarom moderne leefstijlen deze problemen verergeren. Dr. Öhman deelt ook praktische, wetenschappelijk onderbouwde strategieën, gebaseerd op leefstijlgeneeskunde, om ontstekingen te verminderen, de veerkracht te vergroten en duurzame gezonde gewoonten op te bouwen.

Of u nu een zorgprofessional, student bent of iemand die zijn of haar eigen welzijn beter wil begrijpen, dit webinar biedt een helder en praktisch perspectief op een van de belangrijkste gezondheidsthema's van dit moment.

Belangrijkste onderwerpen:
Chronische laaggradige ontsteking uitgelegd
Het verband tussen stress en ontsteking
Leefstijlgewoonten die bijdragen aan gezondheidsrisico's op de lange termijn
Eenvoudige, praktische manieren om ontstekingen op natuurlijke wijze te verminderen
De rol van voeding, slaap en beweging in de algehele gezondheid

Spreker:
Dr. Miina Öhman
Arts-wetenschapper en expert in leefstijlgeneeskunde

Datum: 14 maart 2026
Georganiseerd door PAN India

Vond je deze sessie waardevol? Vergeet dan niet te liken, te delen en je te abonneren voor meer gesprekken over gezondheid, leefstijl en welzijn.

#ChronischeOntsteking #StressManagement #LeefstijlGeneeskunde #Gezondheidswebinar #PreventieveGezondheid #WellnessIndia #PANIndia #GezondLeven #GeestesGezondheid

ml.title: വെബിനാർ 27 | ഡോ. മൈന ഒഹ്മാൻ | ക്രോണിക് ലോ - ഗ്രേഡ് വീക്കം, സമ്മർദ്ദം
ml.description:
വിട്ടുമാറാത്ത കുറഞ്ഞ അളവിലുള്ള വീക്കവും സമ്മർദ്ദവും പലപ്പോഴും അദൃശ്യമാണ്, പക്ഷേ അവ നമ്മുടെ ദൈനംദിന ആരോഗ്യം, ഊർജ്ജ നിലകൾ, ദീർഘകാല ക്ഷേമം എന്നിവയെ നിശബ്ദമായി രൂപപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു. പാൻ ഇന്ത്യ ആതിഥേയത്വം വഹിക്കുന്ന ഈ ഉൾക്കാഴ്ചയുള്ള വെബിനാറിൽ, ഈ അടിസ്ഥാന ഘടകങ്ങൾ നമ്മുടെ ജീവിതശൈലി ശീലങ്ങളെ എങ്ങനെ സ്വാധീനിക്കുന്നുവെന്നും അവ ഫലപ്രദമായി കൈകാര്യം ചെയ്യാൻ നമുക്ക് എന്തുചെയ്യാനാകുമെന്നും ഡോ. ​​മീന ഒഹ്മാൻ വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു.

ഈ സെഷനിൽ, വിട്ടുമാറാത്ത വീക്കം അക്യൂട്ട് വീക്കത്തിൽ നിന്ന് എങ്ങനെ വ്യത്യാസപ്പെട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു, ശാരീരിക തലത്തിൽ സമ്മർദ്ദം ശരീരത്തെ എങ്ങനെ ബാധിക്കുന്നു, ആധുനിക ജീവിതശൈലികൾ ഈ പ്രശ്‌നങ്ങളെ ത്വരിതപ്പെടുത്തുന്നത് എന്തുകൊണ്ടെന്ന് നിങ്ങൾ പഠിക്കും. വീക്കം കുറയ്ക്കുന്നതിനും, പ്രതിരോധശേഷി മെച്ചപ്പെടുത്തുന്നതിനും, സുസ്ഥിരമായ ആരോഗ്യകരമായ ശീലങ്ങൾ വളർത്തിയെടുക്കുന്നതിനും സഹായിക്കുന്ന ജീവിതശൈലി വൈദ്യത്തിൽ വേരൂന്നിയ പ്രായോഗികവും ശാസ്ത്ര പിന്തുണയുള്ളതുമായ തന്ത്രങ്ങളും ഡോ. ​​ഒഹ്മാൻ പങ്കിടുന്നു.

നിങ്ങൾ ഒരു ആരോഗ്യ വിദഗ്ദ്ധനോ, വിദ്യാർത്ഥിയോ, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ സ്വന്തം ക്ഷേമം നന്നായി മനസ്സിലാക്കാൻ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്ന ഒരാളോ ആകട്ടെ, ഇന്നത്തെ ഏറ്റവും പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട ആരോഗ്യ വിഷയങ്ങളിലൊന്നിനെക്കുറിച്ച് വ്യക്തവും പ്രായോഗികവുമായ ഒരു വീക്ഷണം ഈ വെബിനാർ വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്യുന്നു.

പ്രധാന വിഷയങ്ങൾ:
ക്രോണിക് ലോ-ഗ്രേഡ് വീക്കം വിശദീകരിച്ചു
സമ്മർദ്ദവും വീക്കവും തമ്മിലുള്ള ബന്ധം
ദീർഘകാല ആരോഗ്യ അപകടങ്ങൾക്ക് കാരണമാകുന്ന ജീവിതശൈലി ശീലങ്ങൾ
സ്വാഭാവികമായി വീക്കം കുറയ്ക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള ലളിതവും പ്രായോഗികവുമായ വഴികൾ
മൊത്തത്തിലുള്ള ആരോഗ്യത്തിൽ പോഷകാഹാരം, ഉറക്കം, ചലനം എന്നിവയുടെ പങ്ക്

പ്രഭാഷകൻ:
ഡോ. മീന ഒമാൻ
ഫിസിഷ്യൻ സയന്റിസ്റ്റും ലൈഫ്‌സ്റ്റൈൽ മെഡിസിൻ വിദഗ്ദ്ധനും

തീയതി: 2026 മാർച്ച് 14
പാൻ ഇന്ത്യ ഹോസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തത്

ഈ സെഷൻ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് വിലപ്പെട്ടതായി തോന്നിയാൽ, ആരോഗ്യം, ജീവിതശൈലി, ക്ഷേമം എന്നിവയെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള കൂടുതൽ സംഭാഷണങ്ങൾക്കായി ലൈക്ക് ചെയ്യാനും പങ്കിടാനും സബ്‌സ്‌ക്രൈബ് ചെയ്യാനും മറക്കരുത്.

#ക്രോണിക്ഇൻഫ്ലമേഷൻ #സ്ട്രെസ് മാനേജ്മെന്റ് #ലൈഫ്‌സ്റ്റൈൽ മെഡിസിൻ #ഹെൽത്ത്വെബിനാർ #പ്രിവന്റീവ് ഹെൽത്ത് #വെൽനെസ്ഇന്ത്യ #പാൻഇന്ത്യ #ഹെൽത്തിലിവിംഗ് #മൈൻഡ് ബോഡിഹെൽത്ത്

pt-BR.title: WEBINÁRIO 27 | Dra. Inflamação crônica e estresse de baixo grau
pt-BR.description:
A inflamação crônica de baixo grau e o estresse são frequentemente invisíveis, mas silenciosamente moldam nossa saúde diária, níveis de energia e bem-estar a longo prazo. Neste webinar esclarecedor, apresentado pela PAN India, a Dra. Miina Öhman explica como esses fatores subjacentes influenciam nossos hábitos de vida e o que podemos fazer para gerenciá-los de forma eficaz.

Nesta sessão, você aprenderá como a inflamação crônica difere da inflamação aguda, como o estresse impacta o corpo em nível fisiológico e por que os estilos de vida modernos estão acelerando esses problemas. A Dra. Öhman também compartilha estratégias práticas, baseadas na ciência e fundamentadas na medicina do estilo de vida, para ajudar a reduzir a inflamação, melhorar a resiliência e construir hábitos saudáveis ​​sustentáveis.

Seja você um profissional de saúde, estudante ou alguém que busca entender melhor seu próprio bem-estar, este webinar oferece uma perspectiva clara e prática sobre um dos temas de saúde mais importantes da atualidade.

Principais tópicos abordados:
Inflamação crônica de baixo grau explicada
A relação entre estresse e inflamação
Hábitos de vida que contribuem para riscos à saúde a longo prazo
Maneiras simples e práticas de reduzir a inflamação naturalmente
O papel da nutrição, do sono e do movimento na saúde geral

Palestrante:
Dra. Miina Öhman
Médica, Cientista e Especialista em Medicina do Estilo de Vida

Data: 14 de março de 2026
Organizado por PAN India

Se você achou esta sessão útil, não se esqueça de curtir, compartilhar e se inscrever para mais conversas sobre saúde, estilo de vida e bem-estar.

ja.title: ウェビナー 27 |ミイナ・オーマン博士 |慢性的な軽度の炎症とストレス
ja.description:
慢性的な軽度の炎症とストレスは、しばしば目に見えにくいものですが、私たちの日常生活、エネルギーレベル、そして長期的な健康状態に静かに影響を与えています。PAN Indiaが主催するこの有益なウェビナーでは、ミーナ・オーマン博士が、これらの根本的な要因が私たちの生活習慣にどのように影響するのか、そして効果的に管理するために何ができるのかを解説します。

このセッションでは、慢性炎症と急性炎症の違い、ストレスが生理学的レベルで身体に及ぼす影響、そして現代のライフスタイルがこれらの問題を加速させている理由について学びます。オーマン博士はまた、炎症を軽減し、回復力を高め、持続可能な健康習慣を構築するための、生活習慣医学に基づいた実践的で科学的根拠のある戦略も紹介します。

医療従事者、学生、あるいは自身の健康状態をより深く理解したいと考えている方など、どなたにとっても、このウェビナーは、今日最も重要な健康トピックの一つである慢性炎症とストレスについて、明確で実践的な視点を提供します。

主なトピック：
慢性的な軽度炎症について
ストレスと炎症の関連性
長期的な健康リスクにつながる生活習慣
炎症を自然に軽減するシンプルで実践的な方法
栄養、睡眠、運動が健康全般に果たす役割

講師：
ミーナ・オーマン博士
医師兼科学者、ライフスタイル医学専門家

開催日：2026年3月14日
主催：PAN India

このセッションが有益だと感じられた方は、ぜひ「いいね！」、シェア、チャンネル登録をして、健康、ライフスタイル、ウェルビーイングに関するさらなる情報発信にご注目ください。

uk.title: ВЕБІНАР 27 | Доктор Мійна Охман | Хронічне запалення низького ступеня та стрес
uk.description:
Хронічне запалення низького ступеня та стрес часто непомітні, але вони непомітно формують наше щоденне здоров'я, рівень енергії та довгострокове благополуччя. У цьому інформативному вебінарі, організованому PAN India, доктор Мійна Охман розкриває, як ці основні фактори впливають на наші звички способу життя та що ми можемо зробити, щоб ефективно з ними боротися.

На цьому занятті ви дізнаєтеся, чим хронічне запалення відрізняється від гострого запалення, як стрес впливає на організм на фізіологічному рівні та чому сучасний спосіб життя прискорює ці проблеми. Доктор Охман також ділиться практичними, науково обґрунтованими стратегіями, що ґрунтуються на медицині способу життя, які допомагають зменшити запалення, підвищити стійкість та сформувати стійкі здорові звички.

Незалежно від того, чи ви медичний працівник, студент чи людина, яка хоче краще зрозуміти власне благополуччя, цей вебінар пропонує чіткий та практичний погляд на одну з найважливіших тем охорони здоров'я сьогодення.

Ключові теми, що розглядаються:
Пояснення хронічного запалення низького ступеня
Зв'язок між стресом і запаленням
Звички способу життя, які сприяють довгостроковим ризикам для здоров'я
Прості, практичні способи природного зменшення запалення
Роль харчування, сну та руху в загальному стані здоров'я

Доповідач:
Доктор Мійна Охман
Лікар, науковець та експерт з медицини способу життя

Дата: 14 березня 2026 р.
Ведуча PAN India

Якщо ви вважаєте цю сесію корисною, не забудьте поставити лайк, поділитися та підписатися на більше обговорень про здоров'я, спосіб життя та благополуччя.

es-US.title: SEMINARIO WEB 27 | Dra. Miina Öhman | Inflamación crónica de bajo grado y estrés
es-US.description:
La inflamación crónica leve y el estrés suelen ser invisibles, pero influyen silenciosamente en nuestra salud diaria, niveles de energía y bienestar a largo plazo. En este interesante seminario web organizado por PAN India, la Dra. Miina Öhman explica cómo estos factores subyacentes influyen en nuestros hábitos de vida y qué podemos hacer para gestionarlos eficazmente.

En esta sesión, aprenderá la diferencia entre la inflamación crónica y la aguda, cómo el estrés afecta al cuerpo a nivel fisiológico y por qué los estilos de vida modernos están acelerando estos problemas. La Dra. Öhman también comparte estrategias prácticas, con respaldo científico y basadas en la medicina del estilo de vida, para ayudar a reducir la inflamación, mejorar la resiliencia y desarrollar hábitos saludables sostenibles.

Tanto si es un profesional de la salud, un estudiante o alguien que busca comprender mejor su propio bienestar, este seminario web ofrece una perspectiva clara y práctica sobre uno de los temas de salud más importantes de la actualidad.

Temas clave:
Explicación de la inflamación crónica de bajo grado
La relación entre el estrés y la inflamación
Hábitos de vida que contribuyen a riesgos para la salud a largo plazo
Formas sencillas y prácticas de reducir la inflamación de forma natural
El papel de la nutrición, el sueño y el ejercicio en la salud general

Ponente:
Dra. Miina Öhman
Médica científica y experta en medicina del estilo de vida

Fecha: 14 de marzo de 2026
Organizado por PAN India

Si esta sesión te ha resultado útil, no olvides darle a "Me gusta", compartirla y suscribirte para más conversaciones sobre salud, estilo de vida y bienestar.

iw.title: וובינר 27 | ד"ר מיינה אוהמן | דלקת ומתח כרוני נמוך
iw.description:
דלקת כרונית בדרגה נמוכה ולחץ הם לעתים קרובות בלתי נראים, אך הם מעצבים בשקט את בריאותנו היומיומית, את רמות האנרגיה ואת רווחתנו לטווח ארוך. בוובינר מעמיק זה, המתקיים על ידי PAN India, ד"ר מיינה אוהמן, מנתחת כיצד גורמים בסיסיים אלה משפיעים על הרגלי אורח החיים שלנו ומה אנו יכולים לעשות כדי לנהל אותם ביעילות.

במפגש זה, תלמדו כיצד דלקת כרונית שונה מדלקת חריפה, כיצד לחץ משפיע על הגוף ברמה פיזיולוגית, ומדוע אורח חיים מודרני מאיץ בעיות אלו. ד"ר אוהמן משתפת גם אסטרטגיות מעשיות ומגובות מדע, המבוססות על רפואת אורח חיים, כדי לסייע בהפחתת דלקות, שיפור החוסן ובניית הרגלים בריאים בני קיימא.

בין אם אתם אנשי מקצוע בתחום הבריאות, סטודנטים או מישהו המחפש להבין טוב יותר את רווחתכם, וובינר זה מציע פרספקטיבה ברורה ומעשית על אחד מנושאי הבריאות החשובים ביותר כיום.

נושאים עיקריים:
הסבר על דלקת כרונית בדרגה נמוכה
הקשר בין לחץ ודלקת
הרגלי אורח חיים התורמים לסיכונים בריאותיים ארוכי טווח
דרכים פשוטות ומעשיות להפחתת דלקת באופן טבעי
תפקיד התזונה, השינה והתנועה בבריאות הכללית

מרצה:
ד"ר מיינה אוהמן
רופאה מדענית ומומחית לרפואת אורח חיים

תאריך: 14 במרץ 2026
בהנחיית PAN India

אם מצאת את המושב הזה בעל ערך, אל תשכח לעשות לייק, לשתף ולהירשם לשיחות נוספות בנושא בריאות, אורח חיים ורווחה.

id.title: WEBINAR 27 | Dr.Miina Öhman | Peradangan dan Stres Tingkat Rendah Kronis
id.description:
Peradangan kronis tingkat rendah dan stres seringkali tidak terlihat, tetapi secara diam-diam membentuk kesehatan harian, tingkat energi, dan kesejahteraan jangka panjang kita. Dalam webinar informatif yang diselenggarakan oleh PAN India ini, Dr. Miina Öhman menguraikan bagaimana faktor-faktor mendasar ini memengaruhi kebiasaan gaya hidup kita dan apa yang dapat kita lakukan untuk mengelolanya secara efektif.

Dalam sesi ini, Anda akan mempelajari bagaimana peradangan kronis berbeda dari peradangan akut, bagaimana stres memengaruhi tubuh pada tingkat fisiologis, dan mengapa gaya hidup modern mempercepat masalah ini. Dr. Öhman juga berbagi strategi praktis berbasis sains yang berakar pada pengobatan gaya hidup untuk membantu mengurangi peradangan, meningkatkan ketahanan, dan membangun kebiasaan sehat yang berkelanjutan.

Baik Anda seorang profesional kesehatan, mahasiswa, atau seseorang yang ingin lebih memahami kesejahteraan Anda sendiri, webinar ini menawarkan perspektif yang jelas dan dapat ditindaklanjuti tentang salah satu topik kesehatan terpenting saat ini.

Topik utama yang dibahas:
Penjelasan tentang peradangan kronis tingkat rendah
Hubungan antara stres dan peradangan
Kebiasaan gaya hidup yang berkontribusi pada risiko kesehatan jangka panjang
Cara sederhana dan praktis untuk mengurangi peradangan secara alami
Peran nutrisi, tidur, dan gerakan dalam kesehatan secara keseluruhan

en.title: WEBINAR 27 | Dr. Miina Öhman | Chronic Low - Grade Inflammation and Stress
en.description:
Chronic low-grade inflammation and stress are often invisible, but they quietly shape our daily health, energy levels, and long-term wellbeing. In this insightful webinar hosted by PAN India, Dr. Miina Öhman breaks down how these underlying factors influence our lifestyle habits and what we can do to manage them effectively.

In this session, you’ll learn how chronic inflammation differs from acute inflammation, how stress impacts the body at a physiological level, and why modern lifestyles are accelerating these issues. Dr. Öhman also shares practical, science-backed strategies rooted in lifestyle medicine to help reduce inflammation, improve resilience, and build sustainable healthy habits.

Whether you are a health professional, student, or someone looking to better understand your own wellbeing, this webinar offers a clear and actionable perspective on one of the most important health topics today.

Key topics covered:
Chronic low-grade inflammation explained
The link between stress and inflammation
Lifestyle habits that contribute to long-term health risks
Simple, practical ways to reduce inflammation naturally
The role of nutrition, sleep, and movement in overall health

Speaker:
Dr. Miina Öhman
Physician Scientist and Lifestyle Medicine Expert

Date: 14 March 2026
Hosted by PAN India

If you found this session valuable, don’t forget to like, share, and subscribe for more conversations around health, lifestyle, and wellbeing.

#ChronicInflammation #StressManagement #LifestyleMedicine #HealthWebinar #PreventiveHealth #WellnessIndia #PANIndia #HealthyLiving #MindBodyHealth

ru.title: ВЕБИНАР 27 | Доктор Миина Оман | Хроническое воспаление низкой степени тяжести и стресс
ru.description:
Хроническое вялотекущее воспаление и стресс часто незаметны, но незаметно влияют на наше здоровье, уровень энергии и долгосрочное благополучие. В этом содержательном вебинаре, организованном PAN India, доктор Миина Оман подробно рассказывает о том, как эти факторы влияют на наш образ жизни и что мы можем сделать для эффективного управления ими.

На этом вебинаре вы узнаете, чем хроническое воспаление отличается от острого, как стресс влияет на организм на физиологическом уровне и почему современный образ жизни усугубляет эти проблемы. Доктор Оман также поделится практическими, научно обоснованными стратегиями, основанными на медицине образа жизни, которые помогут уменьшить воспаление, повысить устойчивость и сформировать устойчивые здоровые привычки.

Независимо от того, являетесь ли вы медицинским работником, студентом или просто хотите лучше понять свое собственное благополучие, этот вебинар предлагает четкий и действенный взгляд на одну из важнейших тем здравоохранения сегодня.

Основные темы:
Объяснение хронического вялотекущего воспаления
Связь между стрессом и воспалением
Привычки образа жизни, способствующие долгосрочным рискам для здоровья
Простые и практичные способы естественного снижения воспаления
Роль питания, сна и движения в общем состоянии здоровья

Спикер:
Доктор Миина Оман
Врач-ученый и эксперт по медицине образа жизни

Дата: 14 марта 2026 г.
Организатор: PAN India

Если эта сессия оказалась для вас полезной, не забудьте поставить лайк, поделиться ею и подписаться на канал, чтобы получать больше информации о здоровье, образе жизни и благополучии.

ko.title: 웨비나 27 | 미이나 오만 박사 | 만성 저등급 염증 및 스트레스
ko.description:
만성적인 저강도 염증과 스트레스는 눈에 잘 띄지 않지만, 우리의 일상적인 건강, 에너지 수준, 그리고 장기적인 웰빙에 조용히 영향을 미칩니다. PAN India가 주최하는 이번 심도 있는 웨비나에서 미이나 외만 박사는 이러한 근본적인 요인들이 우리의 생활 습관에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지, 그리고 효과적으로 관리하는 방법은 무엇인지 자세히 설명합니다.

이번 웨비나에서는 만성 염증과 급성 염증의 차이점, 스트레스가 신체에 미치는 생리적 영향, 그리고 현대 생활 방식이 이러한 문제들을 악화시키는 이유를 알아볼 수 있습니다. 외만 박사는 또한 염증을 줄이고, 회복력을 높이며, 지속 가능한 건강 습관을 형성하는 데 도움이 되는 실용적이고 과학적인 생활 습관 의학 기반의 전략을 공유합니다.

의료 전문가, 학생, 또는 자신의 웰빙을 더 잘 이해하고자 하는 모든 분들에게 이번 웨비나는 오늘날 가장 중요한 건강 주제 중 하나에 대한 명확하고 실질적인 관점을 제공합니다.

주요 내용:
만성 저강도 염증 설명
스트레스와 염증의 연관성
장기적인 건강 위험을 초래하는 생활 습관
염증을 자연적으로 줄이는 간단하고 실용적인 방법
영양, 수면, 운동이 전반적인 건강에 미치는 영향

강사:
미이나 외만 박사
의학 박사, 과학자 및 라이프스타일 의학 전문가

날짜: 2026년 3월 14일
주최: PAN India

이 웨비나가 유익했다면 좋아요, 공유, 구독을 통해 건강, 라이프스타일, 웰빙에 대한 더 많은 정보를 받아보세요.

recent_videos.title: HEALTHCON WEBINAR 2026 - PAN India
recent_videos.description:
HEALTHCON 2026 brings together experienced clinicians and subject matter experts for an in depth academic session focused on evidence based learning and healthy living. Designed for healthcare professionals across India, this online series explores how informed lifestyle and nutrition choices can support long term wellbeing at both individual and community levels.

The sessions cover key areas including structured approaches to a healthy lifestyle, understanding scientific evidence behind dietary patterns, food quality and safety, and the role of responsible protein choices in building health. Each talk is grounded in current research and clinical experience, offering practical insights that can be applied in everyday medical practice.

With growing interest in preventive care and lifestyle medicine, HEALTHCON 2026 creates space for meaningful dialogue around nutrition science, patient education, and sustainable health outcomes. The programme encourages a holistic view of health that integrates knowledge, consistency, and informed decision making.

Organised by AMC Mumbai and PAN India, this series reflects a shared commitment to academic excellence, professional development, and evidence driven healthcare education.

#HEALTHCON2026 #EvidenceBasedLearning #HealthyLiving #NutritionScience #LifestyleMedicine #MedicalEducation #PreventiveCare #PublicHealth #AMC #PANIndia

te.title: 48వ CME | 14 డిసెంబర్ 2025 | హైదరాబాద్ క్లినికల్ ప్రాక్టీస్‌లో ఆధారాల ఆధారిత పోషకాహారం
te.description:
హైదరాబాద్‌లోని 48వ CMEలో జరిగిన అంతర్దృష్టితో కూడిన చర్చలు, నేటి క్లినికల్ సవాళ్లను పరిష్కరించడంలో ఆధారాల ఆధారిత పోషకాహారం యొక్క కీలక పాత్రను హైలైట్ చేస్తున్నాయి.

🔹 ముఖ్య ప్రసంగం
“భారతదేశంలో ప్రస్తుత పోషకాహార సవాళ్లు మరియు NCDలు”
డాక్టర్ హేమలత R
మాజీ డైరెక్టర్, ICMR–NIN | PAN సలహాదారు

🔹 నిపుణుల ప్రసంగం
“గట్ డిస్‌బయోసిస్‌ను మాడ్యులేట్ చేయడానికి యాంటీ-ఇన్‌ఫ్లమేటరీ డైట్‌లు”
డాక్టర్ దాసరి అనుష
సీనియర్ కన్సల్టెంట్ - ఇంటర్నల్ మెడిసిన్ & ఫంక్షనల్ మెడిసిన్, AIG హాస్పిటల్

ఈ సెషన్‌లు కలిసి, NCDలను నిర్వహించడంలో మరియు రోగి ఫలితాలను మెరుగుపరచడంలో పోషకాహార-నేతృత్వంలోని వ్యూహాల ప్రాముఖ్యతను బలోపేతం చేశాయి.

snippet.title: Physicians Association for Nutrition India
snippet.description:
The Physicians Association for Nutrition (PAN) raises awareness about evidence-based nutrition and its positive impact on promoting health, and preventing and treating diseases. 

PAN India was founded in 2022 and is one of the national branches of PAN International, a global NGO founded in Munich, Germany in 2018.

Our mission is to Integrate Nutrition Specific Interventions into health systems in India by empowering healthcare professionals with the tools, techniques and know-how to treat their patients with the power of Evidence Based Nutrition. 

We provide educational and training programs for healthcare professionals and also effects the much needed change among the general public, industry bodies, and policymakers.

recent_videos.title: Workout deets 🎀
recent_videos.description:
My go-to combo for energy and recovery:
@usadivinenutrition pre-workout & protein wafer bars

1. Hip thrusts: place your upper back on a bench, keep your feet planted and push your hips up! squeeze your glutes at the top and lower down with control

2. Romanian Deadlifts: hold the weight, keep a slight bend in your knees and push your hips back as you lower the weight down your legs! keep your back straight and feel the stretch

3. Hip abduction machine: sit tall and push your legs out against the pads! go slow and squeeze your glutes each rep

4. Cable kickbacks: strap the cable to your ankle and kick your leg back while keeping your body still! focus on squeezing your glute, not swinging

5. Bulgarian split squats: put one foot behind you on a bench and lower into a lunge! push through your front foot to stand back up and take these slow for balance

#glutesworkout #fitness #gym #relatable #explorepage

recent_videos.title: Mr  Tejaswi Surya member parliament highlighted that the consumption of ultra-processed foods (UPFs)
recent_videos.description:
Tejaswi Surya member parliament highlighted that the consumption of ultra-processed foods (UPFs) such as noodles, sugary beverages, and sodas is increasing among children, contributing to a rising burden of various non-communicable diseases (NCDs). Evidence from the Economic Survey and the National Health Survey also indicates a strong link between higher UPF consumption and increasing rates of childhood obesity.

To address this growing public health concern, there is a need for effective policy measures such as define Ultra-processed food, introducing front-of-pack labelling , increasing taxation on UPFs to discourage excessive consumption, and stricter regulations to reduce the advertising of such foods.

recent_videos.title: Mr. Raghav Chadha highlighted the issue of misleading or false advertisements
recent_videos.description:
Raghav Chadha highlighted the issue of misleading or false advertisements. He pointed out that front-of-pack labels often show illustrations of fresh fruits, while in small text it is mentioned that the picture is for marketing purposes only. As a result, consumers purchase and consume these drinks believing them to be healthy and nutritious, which contributes to the rising burden of obesity and other lifestyle diseases.

He called for a ban on misleading advertisements, clear “high in sugar” disclosures on the front of the pack, and better category clarity to ensure consumers can distinguish whether a product is real fruit juice or simply a concentrate with added sugar

recent_videos.creator_name: Nutrition Advocacy in Public Interest-NAPi India
recent_videos.title: Ms. Swati Maliwal MP Speaks on Deceptive Marketing of UPFs and Demands Warning Labels & FOPL
recent_videos.description:
Swati Maliwal exposes how misleading food advertisements falsely promote “health drinks,” atta noodles, biscuits, juices, and protein shakes as healthy, while they are loaded with sugar, refined flour, palm oil, colours, and preservatives. She highlights shocking examples—health drinks with nearly 50% of sugar, cashew biscuits with just 0.9% cashew, and protein shakes for the elderly containing 9g sugar per scoop.

She warns that such deceptive marketing is fuelling non-communicable diseases like diabetes, heart disease, childhood obesity, and hypertension—similar to how misleading tobacco products led to oral cancers .

She demanded clear front-of-pack labelling of packaged food products ,mandatory health warnings on high-sugar products, and stricter regulations to curb misleading advertisements, in order to protect consumer

recent_videos.creator_name: Nutrition Advocacy in Public Interest-NAPi India
recent_videos.title: Mr. Naveen Jindal, MP, on rising ultra-processed food consumption and the need for clear FOPL.
recent_videos.description:
Naveen Jindal spoke about the rapidly increasing consumption of ultra-processed foods and its direct link to the rising prevalence of non-communicable diseases (NCDs). He highlighted that front-of-pack labelling is often inadequate or misleading, leaving consumers unaware that many packaged foods are high in sugar, trans fats, and other harmful ingredients.

He emphasised that consumers frequently do not understand the health risks associated with ultra-processed foods due to poor labelling and lack of transparency. To address this, he strongly advocated for clear and effective front-of-pack labelling, along with QR code–based information systems, to help consumers make informed choices about packaged food products.

He also drew attention to the harmful health effects of refined oils used commonly , stressing the urgent need for greater consumer awareness and stronger regulatory measures to protect public health.

recent_videos.creator_name: Nutrition Advocacy in Public Interest-NAPi India
recent_videos.title: Mr. Subhash Barala, MP- speaks on Ultra-Processed Foods and India’s Growing Health Crisis.
recent_videos.description:
He highlighted how India’s traditional diets—rooted in whole, minimally processed foods—kept generations healthy for centuries. However, he expressed concern that children today are increasingly addicted to sugar- and salt-laden ultra-processed foods (UPFs), which offer little nutritional value and are significantly contributing to the rising burden of diabetes and obesity, particularly among children.

He also drew attention to misleading advertisements that aggressively target children, shaping unhealthy food preferences from an early age. Such practices, he warned, could lead to reduced productivity and a substantial increase in healthcare costs in the coming years.

Emphasizing the need for urgent action, he called for the promotion of whole foods, including traditional grains such as millets, and for strengthening the Eat Right India campaign. Referring to studies from the United States, he noted that ultra-processed foods are deliberately engineered to be addictive, in ways comparable to tobacco. He further advocated for the adoption of strong regulatory measures, similar to those implemented in the United Kingdom, to protect children’s health and ensure a healthier future for the nation.

recent_videos.title: Role of Nutrition in the Prevention of Cardiac Events
recent_videos.description:
PAN EBN 04
Physicians Association for Nutrition India (PAN India) is on a mission to educate the Healthcare community about the major component of sustainable healthcare model, Evidence-Based Nutrition (EBN) Intervention.

EBN-04, we focus on secondary prevention of  Cardiac events and renowned cardiologist Dr G. Rajendran is the speaker. 

Dr Rajendran is the Head of Preventive Cardiology at PSG Medical College, Coimbatore and Director ,VR Heart health initiative with focus on development of a model health village. He is a pioneer in the field of WFPB Nutrition for prevention of cardiac events in India.

He and his multi disciplinary team conducted HARP (Heart Awareness and Rehabilitation Program) for Secondary Prevention in 2019. This program successfully implemented Whole Food Plant Based Diet for all in-Patients

recent_videos.title: Diet Climate Connection
recent_videos.description:
This Webinar, we explored about how our diet can impact Climate & how to accomplish the greatest transformation in human history to Climate Healing Civilisation.

The guest speaker Dr Sailesh Rao is the Founder and Executive Director of Climate Healers, a non-profit dedicated towards healing the Earth’s climate. He has created a Climate Bathtub model to help humanity understand the solution space for reversing climate change and enabling a thriving planet. 
The message of the session was well received among the audience.

recent_videos.title: Evidence Based Nutrition in Healthcare
recent_videos.description:
PAN EBNWebinar -01

Physicians Association for Nutrition India's webinar series -1 on evidence-based nutrition in healthcare setting

Most of us, including doctors and healthcare professionals take Nutrition decisions for ourselves, our families and our patients based on current available scientific evidence. But the issue is that we are currently living in an era of information overload. We are living in a time of highly accessible information, and with the increase in accessibility has come a concomitant increase in misinformation and pseudoscience relating to nutrition. Pseudoscience and anecdotal evidence often get mixed into nutrition statements and health claims, but the best way to separate fact from fiction is to look for evidence-based nutrition.
 
As the Healthcare system shifts into a “Nutrition/Lifestyle first Approach”, Isn’t it better to learn the nuances of evidence based nutrition in clinical settings?

Please watch this webinar recording to understand why Nutrition intervention is very important in clinical practice. 

Please watch and comment. Your feedback will help us improve our upcoming sessions. 
Watch out this space for more videos in this domain.

recent_videos.title: How does the 30 30 diet work?
recent_videos.description:
SUBSCRIBE AND FOLLOW ON INSTAGRAM-@NUTRITIONBYRIAWAHI
When people say they want to lose weight, what they really mean is they want to lose fat.
Most people don’t want to lose muscle, especially as they get older.
Unfortunately, many diets cause muscle to waste away as the kgs come off. That isn’t a great compromise.
The better option is to improve body composition by maintaining lean muscle mass while shedding fat (especially the problematic visceral fat).
This can be accomplished by following what I call the 30/30 Diet.

30+10/30/30 plan is one in which 40% of your daily calories come for 30% complex carbohydrates and 10% we keep for simple carbohydrate sources, 30% of your daily calories come from protein sources, and, you guessed it, 30% of your daily calories come from fat sources.

To know more , book your appointment @riawahi_official
Link in bio👆🏻

recent_videos.title: Intermittent Fasting,Way to work!Food or Time window?
recent_videos.description:
How Long Does Intermittent Fasting Take To Show Results?
You might begin to first notice a difference in your body about 10 days after you begin intermittent fasting. It could take between 2-10 weeks for you to lose significant weight.

How will it work?
The practice of 16/8 intermittent fasting involves limiting your intake of foods and calorie-containing beverages to a set window of 8 hours per day. You abstain from food for the remaining 16 hours, though you're still allowed to drink water and other no-calorie beverages, like plain coffee or tea.

en.title: Intermittent Fasting, Way to work! Food or Time window?
en.description:
How Long Does Intermittent Fasting Take To Show Results? You might begin to first notice a difference in your body about 10 days after you begin intermittent fasting. It could take between 2-10 weeks for you to lose significant weight.

How will it work?
The practice of 16/8 intermittent fasting involves limiting your intake of foods and calorie-containing beverages to a set window of 8 hours per day. You abstain from food for the remaining 16 hours, though you're still allowed to drink water and other no-calorie beverages, like plain coffee or tea.

channel.description:
The Nutrition Foundation of India (NFI) is a non-governmental voluntary organization dedicated to improving the nutritional status of Indians by:
    • Carrying out research on major nutritional problems.
    • Research to operationalize proven interventions to improve nutritional status in national programs.
    • Evaluation of national nutrition programs.
    • Capacity building to improve implementation of national programs.

NFI periodically organizes symposia/seminars/webinars to update knowledge of postgraduate students and mid-level faculty of home science and medical college and workshops to improve the skills of nutrition and health service providers. The videos from these events are uploaded to youtube so that they are readily accessible to postgraduate students, faculty as well as research scholars.

recent_videos.title: The Habits That Shaped Us: Unlearning Our Childhood
recent_videos.description:
In this episode, we’re looking back at the quirks, habits, and cultural norms we were raised with—starting with the way we ate. From the sugary "health" drinks we had before brushing our teeth to the classic distraction of watching TV just to finish a meal, we explore how these early routines impacted our development and our relationship with our bodies.

Beyond the plate, we dive into the broader patterns from our upbringing that we’re still trying to navigate today. Whether it’s nostalgia or a realization of "wait, why did we do that?", join us as we unpack the childhood experiences that made us who we are.

recent_videos.title: Is your tea/coffee habit healthy? | Indian Nutrition Podcast
recent_videos.description:
Tea and coffee are a part of our everyday lives, especially in India. From morning chai to multiple cups of coffee through the day, most of us rely on caffeine without really understanding how it affects our body.

In this episode of our Indian nutrition podcast, we talk about tea, coffee, caffeine, and how these daily habits impact your energy, sleep, gut health, and overall lifestyle.

We discuss
How much tea or coffee is actually okay in a day
The effects of caffeine on your body 
Tea vs coffee which is better

recent_videos.description:
Indian weddings are full of celebrations, late nights, buffets, sweets, and endless food. In Episode 3 of our Indian nutrition podcast, we talk about how to enjoy wedding season without losing balance with your health goals.
We discuss weight loss during wedding season, how to balance eating during weddings, and simple strategies that help you enjoy the celebrations without guilt or extreme dieting. Instead of restricting food or starting another crash diet after weddings, this episode focuses on practical and sustainable weight loss hacks that actually work in real life.

In this episode we talk about
Weight loss during weddings and common mistakes people make
How to balance eating during wedding events and buffets
Simple meal strategies that help you stay satisfied and mindful
How to enjoy sweets and celebration food without overeating
Realistic habits that support sustainable weight loss

If you often feel like weddings completely derail your health routine, this episode will help you approach food with more balance and clarity.

recent_videos.title: 2026 Health Goals | Sustainable Weight Loss in India | Why Fad Diets Fail
recent_videos.description:
In Episode 2 of our Indian nutrition podcast, two sisters talk about 2026 health goals, fad diets explained, and how to balance meals without stress or extremes. We discuss why chasing quick results leads to burnout and how nutrition without dieting is a more sustainable approach.

This episode breaks down common Indian diet myths and Indian weight loss myths, while focusing on sustainable weight loss India through simple, realistic habits. We also talk about gut health and nutrition India, everyday lifestyle choices, and how to build a balanced plate that actually works for Indian households.

If you are looking for honest conversations around food, health, and long term wellbeing without falling into diet culture, this episode is for you.

recent_videos.title: Let's Talk Food- Un-filtered
recent_videos.description:
Growing up in an Indian household, we were taught what to eat but never why.

From “yeh healthy hai” to “ghar ka khana best hota hai”, we followed food rules without really understanding nutrition or lifestyle habits.

In this podcast, two sisters have honest conversations about Indian childhood food habits, nutrition myths, lifestyle changes, gut health, weight loss pressure, and simple nutrition that actually works for Indian households.
This isn’t a preachy health podcast, it’s about unlearning, relearning, and making health realistic and sustainable.

If you grew up confused about food and health, this one’s for you. 🎙️✨

recent_videos.title: Dr. Deodatta Chafekar, Nephrologist Announcing Renal Nutrition, India, June 18th 2020, Navi Mumbai
recent_videos.description:
Launch of Renal Nutrition, India on June 18th 2020, Navi Mumbai, India 

The Indian Association for Parenteral and Enteral Nutrition (IAPEN) is an organization in the field of parenteral and enteral nutrition and promotes basic research, clinical research, advanced education, organization of consensus statements about clinical care and quality control.

Renal Nutrition India is a core group of IAPEN (The Indian Association for parenteral and Enteral Nutrition) is started by Dr. Deodatta Chafekar, Nephrologist, Shri Samarth Hospital, Nashik, Maharashtra and Ms Himani Puri, Clinical Nutritionist, Nashik with the help and support of IAPEN Members and Lifelong Learners in Advanced Clinical Nutrition with more focus on Renal Nutrition.  

Website: http://www.iapenrenal.in

The Renal Nutrition, India, A core group of IAPEN is devoted to the study of metabolic problems associated with renal disease and their nutritional implications and management.

Trained healthcare professionals with sound knowledge about Renal Nutrition play a vital role in aiding management and empowering the patient with the knowledge needed to manage his/her renal diseases and prevent complication and ensure optimal treatment outcomes towards positive health goals.
 
IAPEN main interest is to promote lifelong learning in Advanced Clinical Nutrition and this core group will help in promoting and developing guidelines for renal patients.  

Joining this core group by filling the below form

Registration Link: https://forms.gle/wokZxJKs3meWQj83A

Email  your complete biodata to iapenrenal@gmail.com or call to +91 9890975280 (Dr Himani Puri, Executive Officer, Renal Nutrition, India, A core group of IAPEN).

recent_videos.title: NCI Unfiltered – Episode 01Topic: "अन्नदाता देश में कुपोषित बच्चे"
recent_videos.description:
🎙 NCI Unfiltered – Episode 01
Topic: "अन्नदाता देश में कुपोषित बच्चे"
📅 Date & Time: 8:30 PM | Friday, August 15, 2025
👥 Speakers:

Dr. Kshitij Bhardwaj – Chairman, Nutrition Council of India
Prof. Narsingh Verma – Ex HOD, King Georges Medical University, Lucknow, Principal Hind Medical College, Sitapur Lucknow    

In this very first episode of the NCI Unfiltered Podcast, we address one of India’s deepest paradoxes – why, in a nation known as the "Annadata" (provider of food), millions of children still suffer from malnutrition.

Join our experts as they explore:
The root causes of child malnutrition in India
Gaps in policy, nutrition education, and implementation
Solutions for a healthier, better-nourished future

About NCI Unfiltered:
This podcast by the Nutrition Council of India (NCI) brings raw, research-backed, and unfiltered conversations on food, nutrition, and health – connecting science to society.

🌐 Visit Us: www.nci.org.in

recent_videos.title: If Your Organs Could Talk, They’d Call Out Your Lifestyle 💀
recent_videos.description:
When your organs hold a meeting… your lifestyle gets exposed. 💀

Late-night heavy meals, excess sugar, and lack of movement don’t just make you feel sluggish — over time they can contribute to higher blood pressure, insulin spikes, slower digestion, and added strain on your heart, liver, and lungs.

Your body isn’t overreacting. It’s responding to your daily habits.
Sometimes, small changes in meals, movement, and routine can make a big difference.

Understanding what you eat is the first step toward better metabolic and overall health.

#BodySignals #HealthAwareness #LifestyleHealth #UnderstandWhatYouEat #Nutriiya

recent_videos.title: What Happens Inside Your Body When You Overeat
recent_videos.description:
Meet the three friends inside your body:
Livku (Liver), Panku (Pancreas), and Heartu (Heart). 🫀

They quietly manage every bite you eat.
But when “a little more” becomes “a little too often”…

⚠️ The liver gets overloaded
😮‍💨 The pancreas gets exhausted
😰 The heart takes extra stress

And that’s where obesity and metabolic problems begin.

🚨 Reality check for India:

• 62% of calories in the Indian diet come from carbs
• Protein averages ~12% of daily calories
• 23–24% of adults are overweight
• 71%+ Indians are metabolically unhealthy

Your body doesn’t need extreme diets.
Just balance.

#Nutrition #ObesityAwareness #NutriiyaPeDekh #Nutriiya

recent_videos.description:
Celebrate Holi with a Healthy Thandai that’s nourishing in every sip. 🌸🥛

This festive favourite is loaded with:
✔ Healthy fats
✔ Plant protein
✔ Fibre
✔ Natural sweetness

• Soaked almonds, cashews & pistachios

recent_videos.description:
Don’t miss these 3 powerful seasonal fruit juices perfect for Indian summers — Mango Juice, Pineapple Juice, and Strawberry Juice. 🥭🍍🍓

In this video, we break down the health benefits of seasonal fruits, why fresh juice is better than packaged juice, and how seasonal eating supports immunity, digestion, hydration, and skin health.

If you're looking for: 
✔️Natural immunity boosting drinks
✔️Vitamin C rich fruits
✔️Vitamin A rich foods
✔️Anti-inflammatory fruits
✔️Summer hydration drinks India
✔️Healthy fruit juices for glowing skin
✔️Low calorie fruit options
✔️Natural digestive enzyme foods
✔️Foods for bloating relief
✔️Seasonal eating in India

This video covers it all. 

🥭 Mango Juice Benefits
• Rich in Vitamin A (eye health support)
• Natural digestive enzymes (amylases)
• Quick natural energy source
• Fiber support when blended
• Summer superfruit in India

🍍 Pineapple Juice Benefits
• Contains bromelain (studied for digestion & inflammation)
• High in Vitamin C
• May support gut health
• Hydrating tropical fruit

🍓 Strawberry Juice Benefits
• Antioxidant-rich
• Supports collagen production
• Skin glow support
• Lower calorie seasonal fruit
• High Vitamin C content

Seasonal eating helps improve:
✔ Hydration
✔ Nutrient diversity
✔ Gut health
✔ Metabolic balance
✔ Immunity support

If you're tracking calories, focusing on preventive health, or building better eating habits — seasonal fruit juices can be a smart addition.

recent_videos.title: What Really Influences Our Food Choices? | Why Healthy Eating Isn't So Simple
recent_videos.description:
We often think food choices are simply about knowing what is healthy. But our everyday choices are influenced by much more than nutrition knowledge.



In this video, we explore some of the factors that shape what we eat — including family, culture, habits, time, cost, availability, convenience, and the food environment around us.



We also look at what we mean by healthy eating, and why a healthy diet is about balance, variety, and overall dietary patterns, rather than relying on one "superfood."                                                                                                                     This is an introduction to understanding modern food environments and sets the stage for future videos on ultra-processed foods, food labels, food marketing, sugar, salt, and fat.

 #NutritionEducation #HealthAndNutritionEducation

recent_videos.title: What Is the IMS Act? | How India Protects Breastfeeding Through Public Health Policy
recent_videos.description:
What is the IMS Act, and why does India regulate the promotion of infant milk substitutes and related products?



Breastfeeding is more than nutrition. The environment in which families receive information and make infant-feeding decisions also matters.



In this video, we look at the Infant Milk Substitutes, Feeding Bottles and Infant Foods (Regulation of Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 1992 — the IMS Act, and the public-health reasoning behind it.



We explore:



• Why breastfeeding became an international public-health concern

• The 1981 International Code of Marketing of Breast-milk Substitutes

• India's response through the IMS Act, 1992

• Why the legislation was needed

• What kinds of advertising and promotional practices the Act restricts

• The role of the healthcare environment

• How the law was strengthened in 2003

• The evolution of the legislation from 1992 to 2004

• Why protecting breastfeeding remains a public-health issue



Take-home message:

Protecting breastfeeding is a public health responsibility.



This video is intended for educational purposes and presents the topic from a public-health perspective.



Sources:

1- The_Infant_Milk_Substitutes_Feeding_Bottles_And_Infant_Foods_Regulation_Of_Production_Supply_And_Distribution_Rules_1993.PDF
2- IMS-act.pdf
3- World Health Organization (WHO)
4- UNICEF

recent_videos.description:
Breastfeeding is more than nutrition — it is an important foundation for a child’s health, development and wellbeing. 🤱



In this Breastfeeding Month Special, we explore why breastfeeding matters for babies, mothers, families and society — from supporting immunity and growth to contributing to healthier communities.



📌 WHO recommends: Exclusive breastfeeding for the first 6 months, followed by continued breastfeeding alongside complementary foods up to 2 years and beyond.

recent_videos.title: World Breastfeeding Week | August 1–7, 2026
recent_videos.description:
World Breastfeeding Week is observed every year from 1–7 August to raise awareness about the importance of breastfeeding and the need to create supportive environments for mothers and families.

Theme 2026:
"Breastfeeding for a sustainable start in life: Strengthen what works."

Breastfeeding provides optimal nutrition for infants, supports healthy growth and development, and benefits both babies and mothers. Supporting breastfeeding is a shared responsibility involving families, healthcare providers, workplaces, communities, and policymakers.

#WorldBreastfeedingWeek #WBW2026 #Breastfeeding #InfantNutrition #MaternalHealth #PublicHealth #HealthandNutritionEducation #TheNutritionChronicles

recent_videos.title: Why Knowing What's Healthy Doesn't Mean We Eat Healthy
recent_videos.description:
Why do we still struggle to eat healthy even when we know what healthy eating looks like?



Many of us know that fruits and vegetables are good for our health and that eating too much sugar isn't. Yet making healthy food choices isn't always easy.



In this video, we explore why healthy eating is about much more than knowledge. Our food choices are influenced by habits formed in childhood, our food environment, convenience, marketing, affordability, and accessibility. Understanding these factors is an important part of public health nutrition and helps us see nutrition beyond individual willpower.



Whether you're a student of nutrition or public health, a healthcare professional, or simply someone interested in understanding food choices.

recent_videos.title: Healthy Indian Snacks You NEED To Try
recent_videos.description:
Evening snacks ko banaye healthy! 😍 Yeh simple swaps try karo aur fark dekho:

🍟 Chips ki jagah Roasted Makhana: Fried ko karo bye! Makhana light hai, full rakhta hai aur guilt-free crunch deta hai. Minerals bhi extra! ✨

🍪 Biscuits ki jagah Khakhra + Chutney: Maida chodo, fiber apnao! Whole wheat khakhra digestion ke liye best hai. 🌱

🥟 Samosa ki jagah Moong Dal Chilla Roll: Heavy fried kyu khana? Moong dal chilla se milega protein aur energy, kam tel mein! 💪

🥤 Cola ki jagah Nimbu Pani + Rock Salt: Sugary drinks ko NO! Nimbu pani hai refreshing, Vitamin C se bhara, aur hydrates too! 💧

🥜 Fried Peanuts ki jagah Ubla Hua Chana: Faltu ka fat kyu? Boiled chana protein aur fiber ka powerhouse hai. Pet bhi bhara rahega! 😋

Healthy living, simple steps! Kaunsa swap aapka favourite hai? Comments mein batao! 👇

recent_videos.title: क्या आप भी पानी पीना भूल जाते हो? #shorts #summerdrink #healthtips
recent_videos.description:
Did you know your body is about 60% water? When you don't drink enough, your organs start sending SOS signals… 👇

🧠 Brain: Losing just 2% of your fluids shrinks brain cells, leading to brain fog and poor concentration.
❤️ Heart: Lower blood volume makes your heart race to deliver oxygen-no wonder you feel your pulse pounding!
🩸 Blood: Thicker blood raises blood pressure and slows circulation.
🩺 Kidneys: Without enough water, waste products concentrate-raising your risk of stones and toxin buildup.
🍽️ Digestion: Less water = slower gut motility, leading to bloating, constipation, and that heavy feeling.
💪 Muscles & Joints: Dehydration can trigger cramps and joint stiffness.
✨ Skin: Cells lose their plumpness-hello dryness, fine lines, and dullness.

If you're in the "I always forget to drink" club, set a timer: a glass every 15–20 minutes can transform how you feel! 🚰💦

👉 Tag a friend who needs this reminder…
👉 Follow @nutritionHindi for more science‑backed wellness hacks! 🔔

#NutritionEnglish #HealthTips #Hydration #StayHydrated #Wellness #HealthyLifestyle #GutHealth

🧠 Brain: Losing just 2% of your fluids shrinks brain cells, leading to brain fog and poor concentration.
❤️ Heart: Lower blood volume makes your heart race to deliver oxygen-no wonder you feel your pulse pounding!
🩸 Blood: Thicker blood raises blood pressure and slows circulation.
🩺 Kidneys: Without enough water, waste products concentrate-raising your risk of stones and toxin buildup.
🍽️ Digestion: Less water = slower gut motility, leading to bloating, constipation, and that heavy feeling.
💪 Muscles & Joints: Dehydration can trigger cramps and joint stiffness.
✨ Skin: Cells lose their plumpness-hello dryness, fine lines, and dullness.

If you're in the "I always forget to drink" club, set a timer: a glass every 15–20 minutes can transform how you feel! 🚰💦

recent_videos.title: Tired of wearing specs? Try this natural way to improve eyesight! #eyecaretips #eyecare #shorts
recent_videos.description:
"The Secret to Reducing Eye Strain 👁️✨
That No Eye Doctor Will Tell You!"

Did you know your eyes have a tiny muscle called the Ciliary Muscle?
It tightens when you look at things up close (like your phone 📱), and relaxes when you look far away — at the sky, clouds, or birds 🕊️.

But with hours spent staring at screens, this muscle stays tight for too long… leading to eye strain and worsening vision over time.

Good news — you can fix this naturally!
Just spend 30-40 minutes daily looking at distant objects — trees, clouds, mountains, or the horizon.
It helps your eye muscles relax, reducing tension and slowing down number changes.

Your eyes will thank you! 🌿
👉 Share this with a friend who wears glasses — it might change their life too.

#EyeHealth #RelaxYourEyes #ScreenTimeTips #VisionCare #MindfulLiving

recent_videos.title: भारतीयों का पेट बाहर क्यों निकलता है? #shorts
recent_videos.description:
Why do Indian ies have potbelly?


Fruits That May Cause Bloating:

 • Apples & Pears: High in fructose and sorbitol, along with soluble fiber.

 • Mangoes: Rich in fructose.

 • Peaches & Plums: Contain sorbitol, which can be hard to digest.

 • Dried Fruits (Apricots, Prunes, Raisins): Concentrated sources of both fructose and fiber.

 • Watermelon: High in fructose.

 • Cherries, Beets, & Peas: Packed with FODMAPs that ferment in the gut.



Grains That May Cause Bloating:

 • Wheat: Contains gluten and fructans.

 • Rye & Barley: Also sources of gluten and fructans.

 • Whole Wheat Products (Bread, Cereals, Pasta): High in fiber and fructans.

 • Bran Products (Wheat Bran, Oat Bran): Loaded with insoluble fiber that can produce gas.

 • Oatmeal: For some, the soluble fiber ferments and leads to bloating.

To support a healthy digestive system, try these strategies:

 • Intermittent Fasting: Give your stomach a break with a 16-hour fasting window.

 • Increase Protein Intake: Incorporate foods like dal, paneer, fish, and eggs, and avoid overly fiber-dense items that cause bloating.

 • Supplement Support: Consider supplements like apple cider vinegar or betaine HCl to boost stomach acid and keep harmful bacteria at bay.

 • Dried Fruits (Apricots, Prunes, Raisins): Concentrated sources of both fructose and fiber.

 • Watermelon: High in fructose.

 • Cherries, Beets, & Peas: Packed with FODMAPs that ferment in the gut.



Grains That May Cause Bloating:

 • Wheat: Contains gluten and fructans.

 • Rye & Barley: Also sources of gluten and fructans.

 • Whole Wheat Products (Bread, Cereals, Pasta): High in fiber and fructans.

 • Bran Products (Wheat Bran, Oat Bran): Loaded with insoluble fiber that can produce gas.

 • Oatmeal: For some, the soluble fiber ferments and leads to bloating.

To support a healthy digestive system, try these strategies:

 • Intermittent Fasting: Give your stomach a break with a 16-hour fasting window.

 • Increase Protein Intake: Incorporate foods like dal, paneer, fish, and eggs, and avoid overly fiber-dense items that cause bloating.

 • Supplement Support: Consider supplements like apple cider vinegar or betaine HCl to boost stomach acid and keep harmful bacteria at bay.

recent_videos.title: P-57.5/C-34.5/F-28.91Shivam Dawar #ProteinIsMyZindagi #GuruMannBreakfastChallenge #GuruMannChallenge
recent_videos.description:
Protein- 57.55
Carbs- 34.5
Fat- 28.918
______________________
Raw material used
1- Oats 25 gram
2- Non fat milk with extra protein 
3- 1 spoon peanut butter 
4- almonds (12)
5- walnut (6)
6- whey isolate 35 grams
_____________________
Method of preparation 
1) soak oats in water
2) put fry pan on stove and add milk 
3) put peanut butter in milk and stir it well
4) drain water from the oats and put it in fry pan
5) crush almonds and walnut and put it in fry pan
7)add whey isolate in fry pan and mix all the incredients well
8) put the material in the mould and let it freeze
_____________________
Talking about price and comparing it with protein bar available in market. 
20 gram protein bar cost around 100
But if we make 20 gram protein bar with this method it will cost around 40 which means less than half. 
_____________________
Benefits of this breakfast 
1) u can prepare it in the night and have it in the morning on the way to office 
2) it melts as soon as you put it in your mouth
3) stomach filling 
4) u can store it for days
5) easy to carry 
6) less messy 
7) easy to cook
8) good fat carb and protein ratio 
______________________
Don't forget to like, share and subscribe.

recent_videos.title: The Truth About Fast Weight Loss
recent_videos.description:
Weight loss is not just about reaching a lower number on the weighing scale. What matters is building healthy habits that help you achieve your goals and maintain your progress in the long run.

In this video, we talk about an important aspect of the weight loss journey that is often overlooked — how to approach weight loss in a healthy and sustainable way.

recent_videos.description: Lifestyle and hypertension in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) (LMICs) are challenged by limited access to healthcare and resources, leading to higher hypertension risk despite higher prevalence in middle and high-income countries. Solutions involve implementing public health initiatives like salt reduction policies and taxes on sugar and alcohol, alongside promoting cost-effective health education, improving access to affordable medications, training community health workers, and leveraging mobile health (mHealth) applications for better management.
